d3.payload.title: Camera load
set.drone.payload.help: What the cinelifter carries under its frame. iFlight sells the Taurus X8 without a camera and allows up to 3 kg; the motors stay the same, so the weight, thrust-to-weight and hover throttle change with the camera. Chosen on the drone picker's 3D view; the other drones ignore it.
d3.f.ducted: Each propeller in its own duct
d3.f.coaxial: Eight propellers in four coaxial pairs
d3.f.records: Records video itself, so it is not an extra camera
d3.f.tilt: Tilts {min} to {max} deg; set to {now} deg here
d3.f.noneRecords: Not carried: the {name} records video itself
d3.f.noCamera: Flies at the maker's take-off weight, {g} g
d3.cine.note: Sold without a camera. iFlight's page names RED Komodo, Z CAM and Blackmagic BMPCC as examples and allows up to 3 kg. This preset carries a {camera} rig of {g} g, the load of iFlight's own hover-time figure (the drone alone weighs {maker} g with its pack).
